rules.title: Custom: debug/staging endpoint referenced
rules.description: A hostname that appears to be a non-production endpoint was found in the APK.
rules.remediation: Remove development endpoints from production builds or protect them with authentication.

rules.title: Custom: premium-rate SMS number
rules.description: A hardcoded destination number was found next to an SMS-sending API. Premium-rate numbers can cause financial loss.
rules.remediation: Remove premium-rate destinations, require explicit user confirmation and use a backend for billing operations.

rules.title: Custom: hardcoded cryptographic IV
rules.description: A cryptographic IV appears to be constructed from a fixed byte array.
rules.remediation: Generate a random IV for every encryption operation and store it alongside the ciphertext.
